messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.example>
To: Amir Hussain <amir@greenleafanalytics.com>
Cc: finance@greenleafanalytics.com
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Invoice 2026-112: wire instructions and payment timing request

Hi Amir —

Hope you had a good weekend. I wanted to follow up on Invoice 2026-112 for $41,250 (attached). The invoice is due in two business days and, to avoid any suspension of Dedicated capacity during migration next week, we wanted to confirm timing for payment.

For convenience I attached our wire instructions and the PDF of the invoice: Invoice_2026-112.pdf (pdf), Wiring_Instructions_Redwood_2026.pdf (txt). If ACH is preferred, let me know and I can check whether your bank supports USD ACH / cross-border ACH from your region.

Requested next steps:
- If paying by wire: please initiate by end of day Wednesday (12/1) and reply here with the remittance reference and bank trace (SWIFT/MT103) when available.
- If paying by ACH or credit card: reply with the preferred method and I will route to finance to provide details.
- If you need a VAT-verified invoice with a full tax breakdown for your records, confirm your billing entity name and VAT ID and we will issue immediately.

If there are any procurement documents you need from our side (W-9, vendor form, bank verification) say the word and I will loop in finance.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround on this.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Amir Hussain <amir@greenleafanalytics.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.example>
Cc: finance@greenleafanalytics.com
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 11:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Invoice 2026-112: wire instructions and payment timing request

Thanks Tessa — appreciate the heads-up. We received the invoice and the PO has been approved on our side (attached PO_78922.pdf). A couple of notes from procurement:

- Greenleaf prefers to pay via wire for cross-border invoices. ACH is not available from our EU banking setup for USD denominated invoices.
- We require two items before initiating the wire: a vendor bank verification letter (one-page showing account holder name and account number) and a VAT-compliant invoice that includes our VAT number. Our finance team copied on this thread (finance@greenleafanalytics.com) can confirm.

We expect to kick off the wire tomorrow morning (Mon 11/30) once we receive the bank verification. If for any reason that slips we will send a remittance estimate.

-Remit details for reference: Greenleaf Analytics Ltd — VAT GB987654321

Amir Hussain
Head of Ops | Greenleaf Analytics
amir@greenleafanalytics.com

Amir — we can absolutely accept wire. If you prefer, we can also accept a USD SWIFT credit or a corporate ACH from a US subsidiary; please advise if either is an option. Otherwise the wiring instructions Tessa attached should work.

Next steps (proposed):
1) Laura to send bank verification + VAT invoice with breakdown (ETA this morning).
2) Amir to initiate wire and reply with remittance reference + MT103 when available.
3) Redwood to mark the account as paid immediately upon receipt of trace and update provisioning team.

Appreciate the fast coordination here — we want to avoid any disruption during your migration window.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
